# CloudBoost

CloudBoost is a native macOS menu bar app for cleaner gaming sessions on Mac.

Primary URL: https://victorbrandaao.github.io/CloudBoost/
GitHub releases: https://github.com/victorbrandaao/CloudBoost/releases/latest
Support: https://discord.gg/kU5trxtRb
Reviews: https://victorbrandaao.github.io/CloudBoost/reviews.html
Trust Center: https://victorbrandaao.github.io/CloudBoost/trust.html
Guides: https://victorbrandaao.github.io/CloudBoost/guides.html

## Summary

CloudBoost helps Mac players start a focused gaming session, reduce local macOS interruptions, and understand latency spikes that normal speed tests often miss.

Version 4.0.9 hardens the in-app updater with required SHA256 verification, improves Gumroad license validation, clarifies Background Traffic wording, separates verified vs requested session actions, and treats CrossOver/Whisky as compatibility-layer profiles instead of native Mac profiles.

It is built for:

- GeForce NOW
- Xbox Cloud Gaming
- Boosteroid
- Moonlight
- PS Remote Play
- Steam Link
- native Mac games
- Dota 2, League of Legends, and CS2 cloud or remote sessions
- Steam, Epic Games, and Battle.net sessions
- PRO diagnostics for CrossOver, Whisky, Wine, and Game Porting Toolkit

## What It Watches

- latency spikes
- jitter
- packet loss
- UDP availability
- background traffic
- AWDL, AirDrop, Handoff, and Wi-Fi interruptions
- DNS state
- Low Power Mode
- thermal pressure
- CPU and local system pressure

## Limits

CloudBoost is not a magic FPS booster.

It does not modify games, inject code, bypass anti-cheat, edit CrossOver bottles, install kernel extensions, or promise large FPS gains. It focuses on the local macOS session around the game.

## Plans

Free includes manual sessions, core cloud, remote play, native Mac and competitive profiles, Balanced preset, basic signal checks, Stream Advisor, and rollback protection.

PRO adds automation, HUD, Session Doctor full reports, Session Lab, Stream Signal, PRO Widgets, Heat Guard, Keep Alive, Session Proof, Kernel Watch, background throttle, CrossOver/Whisky diagnostics, priority Discord support, early builds, and deeper diagnostics.

PRO also includes Session Doctor Fix actions, session end reports, and deeper before/after diagnostics.

Session Proof lets PRO users copy a support-ready report with profile, preset, app version, macOS version, selected diagnostics, Session Doctor result, Session Lab result, before/after summary, and recent CloudBoost events. It does not include license keys, personal files, hostnames, or browser history.

Launch price test: CloudBoost PRO is currently $4.99. It is the full one-time CloudBoost 4.x PRO license, not a 7-day rental or subscription.
